newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK SAYS INKO BALTI REQUIREMENTS MET.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK SAYS INKO BALTI REQUIREMENTS MET.

text.p: The Estonian central bank said on Monday that Inko Balti Pank has met its equity requirements according to preliminary data, but added it can not give a final estimate until an inspection is finished.
"The regular inspection is going on in the bank," a central bank spokesperson told Reuters.
The bourse earlier said that it had postponed Inko Balti Pank's membership application because it did not meet the equity requirements of the central bank.
Inko Balti Pank's equity was 63.3 million kroons as of March, but there is always a chance that the requirement has not really been met, the central bank spokesperson said.
Estonia's commercial banks' minimum equity capital must be 50 million kroons.
